title: Benchmark catalog
subtitle: Add a ready-made benchmark to your project in one click. Examples and bundled suites copy straight in; public benchmarks are imported from data on the server.
fromHelp: A clone or download of the upstream data. Relative paths resolve against your project folder.
loadError: Could not load the catalog. Check that the server is running, then reload.
empty: No benchmarks match. Clear the search or pick another filter.
noSource: This server could not find its bench folder, so examples and bundled suites are hidden. Ask the server owner to set HEIMDALL_CATALOG_ROOT.
starter: Every new org starts with these agents: {{agents}}.
importStarted: Import job started. Its log is below; the suite appears when it finishes.
